notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Program.Professions.cs is MSUI's TradeSkillFrame: opens client-side off the effect-47 opener spell (TryOpenProfession), ClassTrainer/TradeSkill shell art, skill line title + rank value, scrolled recipe list with vanilla difficulty colors (orange/yellow/green/grey from trivial thresholds), detail pane with product icon, reagents with have/need counts red-tinted when short, tools and spell-focus requirement lines with red unmet tint, Create / Create All (batched recasts) / Cancel / Exit, craft-cast confirmation observation.
